answer: Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The opal of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on invitation quota tree, split across independent auditors, no identity may audit its own recruit. The terrace holds work receipts rather than names, so the grove of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
